verdicts.reasons: Feasible for round 0's static material: the supplied HTML and CSS show two trip cards, with no scripts, storage, or external dependencies. Desktop and mobile screenshots show readable layouts at the supplied sizes; other viewport sizes were not tested. The page supports the stated two-trip scope, but hardcoded attendance cannot support shared planning or saved responses; the inert buttons match this round's scope. Standard HTML, CSS, and system fonts offer good longevity with little dependency upkeep, although someone must manually update dates and costs. No paid service is required by these files. Budget fit remains unverified: the recorded $0.13 spend leaves about $3.87, but there is no measured remaining build cost or hosting and upkeep price basis. No network checks were possible.
